documents: Blue lamps can be returned within 30 days of delivery.
Red lamps can be returned within 14 days of delivery.
The North branch opens at 11:00 on Sundays.
The South branch closes at 17:00 on Sundays.
The Atlas sensor requires one CR2032 coin battery.
The Atlas remote control requires two AAA batteries.
Use Forgot password on the sign-in page to receive a password-reset email.
Open Profile settings and edit Display name to change the name others see.
Bicycles are allowed on the River ferry for a 3 euro supplement.
Bicycles are prohibited on the Mountain cable car.
CSV uploads are limited to 25 MB per file.
PDF uploads are limited to 10 MB per file.
The Basic plan requires an internet connection and does not support offline access.
The Pro plan includes offline access.
Store uncured resin between 15 and 25 degrees Celsius away from sunlight.
Apply the finished coating only above 10 degrees Celsius.
Expense claims exceeding 500 euros require finance-manager approval.
Team leads approve expense claims of 500 euros or less.
Nightly backups are retained for seven days.
Monthly backups are retained for twelve months.
Blue lamps have a two-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
The North branch opens at 08:00 on Mondays.
The South branch closes at 20:00 on Saturdays.
The Atlas Pro sensor requires a CR2450 battery.
To change your billing address, open Billing settings.
The River ferry offers free tickets for children under five.
CSV exports can contain up to 100000 rows.
Annual backups are retained for five years.
